headline: Your wallet. Your rules.
summary: CopyPump is a non-custodial Solana automation project focused on bounded authority, deterministic risk controls and traceable execution. Mainnet remains intentionally blocked while the technical alpha is validated.

gates.label: Website
gates.detail: Public product, architecture and evidence surface

gates.label: Policy + risk
gates.detail: Deterministic capital, slippage, exposure and permission controls

gates.label: Audit evidence
gates.detail: Decision, execution, reconciliation and accounting trace

gates.label: Devnet lifecycle
gates.detail: BUY → partial sell → full sell with failure-path validation

gates.label: Mainnet access
gates.detail: Blocked until required validation gates pass

roadmap.label: NEXT
roadmap.title: Close the remaining Devnet execution-safety gates
roadmap.copy: Storage hardening moved forward. Real Devnet trading acceptance still depends on the remaining durable execution, recovery and verification gates.

roadmap.label: PROVE
roadmap.title: Publish reviewable Devnet evidence
roadmap.copy: Release transaction, reconciliation and accounting evidence only after the relevant acceptance checks pass.

roadmap.label: AFTER THE GATES
roadmap.title: Evaluate limited production readiness
roadmap.copy: Mainnet remains locked. Production preparation is conditional on separate evidence and approval.

latestMilestone.title: Stage 4A/4B scoped storage engineering progress published
latestMilestone.summary: CopyPump Stage 4A and 4B passed their scoped closed-gate synthetic storage engineering acceptance. Price Alerts, bounded active receipts and verified indexed archival reached those engineering checkpoints. Real storage activation and real Devnet trading remain unaccepted, and LIVE_MAINNET stays locked.

community.callToAction: Follow the build, inspect the public record, and join the discussion if you care about bounded authority, execution safety or testing the assumptions behind CopyPump.
